newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Arranger group forms for Indonesia credit facility.
newsitem.headline: Arranger group forms for Indonesia credit facility.

text.p: Fourteen banks have joined the Republic of Indonesia's US$500 million eight-year syndicated credit facility as arrangers, JP Morgan said on Friday.
Coordinating arrangers are Commerzbank (South East Asia), Fuji Bank, IBJ Asia, JP Morgan Securities Asia, NatWest Markets, Sanwa International Finance and Tokyo-Mitsubishi International (HK).

The arrangers are Asahi Bank's Singapore branch, Bank of Taiwan's Tokyo branch, Banque Nationale de Paris's Singapore branch, Chase Manhattan Asia, Commonwealth Bank of Australia's Singapore branch, Daiwa Overseas Finance, DKB Asia, Dresdner (South East Asia), Korea Development Bank, LTCB Asia, Nippon Credit Bank's Singapore branch, Norinchukin Bank's Singapore branch, Sakura Merchant Bank (Singapore) and Tokai Bank's Singapore branch.
The interest rate will be calculated at an annual rate equal to the London Interbank Offered Rate plus a margin of five-eighths of one percent, JP Morgan said.
Proceeds will be used to provide general purpose funds for the Republic of Indonesia.
